whatsNew:
The thread stops fighting itself

Sending in a group made the conversation scroll somewhere else and come back. That was the list holding its position against the message you had just sent. It doesn't any more.

In a one-to-one chat the thread sometimes stopped short of the newest message. It was jumping before the bubble had been measured — a photo, a link card or a translation line landing a moment later. It now follows the message until it has settled, and stops the moment you scroll up yourself.

Messages arriving quickly

In a busy group, everything after the first message was waiting for a background check half a minute later. That was a mistake I made in 3.7. Fixed.

Also

- You can report someone from the group they are in, not only from Contacts.

Please check

- Send a few messages in a group and watch the thread.
- Have someone send you several quickly.
- Send a photo and see whether the thread stays with it.
